definition: The volume-weighted mean of the typical price (high + low + close) / 3 since the session opened. Each bar carries its close time in nanoseconds UTC as time; a session opens at session_start seconds into its clock's day and lasts until the next one opens.
boundaries: On FX and CFD bars the volume is a tick count, so it is a quote-weighted proxy. Bars without a time are missing. session_start is a second of clock's day: clock 0 is UTC, 1 is London and 2 is New York, so a session opens at the market's own time on both sides of a clock change. No bar carries its volume yet, so compile refuses this block until one does.
recognition: Price above the session VWAP reads as buyers in control of the day.

sources.quote: the average price weighted by volume
The cumulative volume-weighted average traded price over a session

fallback.expected_loss: FX and CFD bars carry a tick count, not traded size, so the reading follows quote activity rather than volume

tests: on clock 0 its values equal version 1's over its golden bars, in qml/tests/test_session_clock.py
